# Yuno Universal SDK (v2) · Web examples

> Ten payment and enrollment scenarios on the Yuno Universal SDK (v2) for Web, in vanilla JavaScript, React and Angular, sharing one Express merchant server. Start at README.md.

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md): quick start, how a payment flows, scenario table, bundle URL, configuration
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): conventions every change must follow
- [server/index.js](server/index.js): the merchant server, six /api routes
- [types/sdk-payments.d.ts](types/sdk-payments.d.ts): interim types for window.SdkPayments

## Vanilla JavaScript (clients/vanilla)
- [sdk.js](clients/vanilla/sdk.js): loads the bundle once, exposes loadSdk() and showStatus()
- [api.js](clients/vanilla/api.js): the six server calls
- [card-form-managed.js](clients/vanilla/card-form-managed.js): SDK form, SDK creates the payment
- [card-form-manual.js](clients/vanilla/card-form-manual.js): SDK form, your server creates the payment
- [card-form-own-button.js](clients/vanilla/card-form-own-button.js): hidden SDK button, submit() from yours
- [payment-list-managed.js](clients/vanilla/payment-list-managed.js): payment method list view, then start()
- [payment-list-manual.js](clients/vanilla/payment-list-manual.js): the list with createPayment
- [wallets.js](clients/vanilla/wallets.js): Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal buttons
- [headless.js](clients/vanilla/headless.js): card data passed to start(), no SDK UI
- [secure-fields.js](clients/vanilla/secure-fields.js): PCI-isolated fields in your form
- [enrollment.js](clients/vanilla/enrollment.js): customerSession saves a card
- [show-loading.js](clients/vanilla/show-loading.js): your own loader

## React (clients/react)
- [src/hooks/use-transaction.ts](clients/react/src/hooks/use-transaction.ts): one transaction per mounted component, StrictMode-safe, unmount on cleanup
- [src/lib/sdk.ts](clients/react/src/lib/sdk.ts): loads the bundle once; formatStatus()
- [src/lib/api.ts](clients/react/src/lib/api.ts): the six server calls
- [src/app.tsx](clients/react/src/app.tsx): scenario list and one route per scenario
- [src/scenarios/card-form-managed.tsx](clients/react/src/scenarios/card-form-managed.tsx): React version of card-form-managed
- [src/scenarios/card-form-manual.tsx](clients/react/src/scenarios/card-form-manual.tsx): React version of card-form-manual
- [src/scenarios/card-form-own-button.tsx](clients/react/src/scenarios/card-form-own-button.tsx): React version of card-form-own-button
- [src/scenarios/payment-list-managed.tsx](clients/react/src/scenarios/payment-list-managed.tsx): React version of payment-list-managed
- [src/scenarios/payment-list-manual.tsx](clients/react/src/scenarios/payment-list-manual.tsx): React version of payment-list-manual
- [src/scenarios/wallets.tsx](clients/react/src/scenarios/wallets.tsx): React version of wallets
- [src/scenarios/headless.tsx](clients/react/src/scenarios/headless.tsx): React version of headless
- [src/scenarios/secure-fields.tsx](clients/react/src/scenarios/secure-fields.tsx): React version of secure-fields
- [src/scenarios/enrollment.tsx](clients/react/src/scenarios/enrollment.tsx): React version of enrollment
- [src/scenarios/show-loading.tsx](clients/react/src/scenarios/show-loading.tsx): React version of show-loading
